wrote /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/obj/msg_streams.txt: fix(streams): seven divergences the audit's own probes found, in three families

Round 6 of the audit asked the three models for PHP PROGRAMS rather than opinions. They named 61;
running every one against `php -n` 8.5.6 gave 14 identical, 12 divergent and 4 that elephc refuses
to compile. This commit closes what the divergences pointed at, in three groups. They land together
because their tests share one file.

## 1. The context-options family

`stream_context_set_options()` carried the deprecation that exists to send callers TO it. php 8.3
added the plural name AND deprecated the two-argument
